title: Specialist bank completes £9.8m portfolio refinance
summary:
Hampshire Trust Bank has completed a £9.8m portfolio refinance across 40 properties in the North West, replacing existing debt and releasing capital for the landlord to pursue further acquisitions. The specialist bank provided two facilities of £7.7m and £2.1m across separate borrowing entities.

title: First-time buyer homes surveyed across England regions
summary:
A survey of new-build properties aimed at first-time buyers across England reveals pricing from £224,995 to £460,000. The developments range from urban regeneration projects to rural villages, demonstrating significant geographical pricing disparities.

title: Webbers Estate Agents reports client data breach
summary:
Webbers Estate Agents has notified clients that their personal information may have been compromised following a security incident involving a third-party service provider. The South West-based firm confirmed it has reported the breach to the Information Commissioner's Office.

title: Lomond acquires second Liverpool agency in expansion drive
summary:
Lomond has acquired City Residential, its second purchase in Liverpool as the estate agency group continues its expansion in the northwest England market. The acquisition follows Lomond's earlier purchase of Homesure, which marked the group's initial entry into Liverpool.

title: UK mortgage lending falls as lenders predict modest recovery
summary:
UK mortgage availability and demand declined in the third quarter of 2025, with lenders anticipating only a marginal improvement in the final three months of the year. Bank of England data shows both lending availability and borrower demand fell across house purchases and remortgaging.

title: Taylor Wimpey withdraws from London housing market
summary:
Taylor Wimpey has ceased building new homes in London, citing deteriorating development viability in the capital as costs continue to rise and profit margins diminish. The national housebuilder's withdrawal marks a significant shift in the London new homes market.

The post Taylor Wimpey withdraws from London housing market appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Estate agents face shift as AI search changes marketing
summary:
Estate agents are adapting marketing strategies as AI platforms increasingly replace traditional search engines for property service queries. The shift requires optimisation across ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Microsoft Copilot and Perplexity AI, each with distinct requirements.

title: New first-time buyer scheme unlikely to replace family help
summary:
The Government's Your First Home scheme is unlikely to eliminate first-time buyers' reliance on family financial support, according to mortgage industry analysis. Data shows family contributions make up a median 59% of deposits, with restrictions on the new scheme limiting its potential impact.

title: First-time buyer affordability concerns outweigh rate worries
summary:
More than half of prospective first-time buyers cite monthly mortgage affordability as their primary concern rather than securing mortgage approval, according to recent survey data. The research found that 52% are primarily worried about monthly repayment costs relative to their overall financial commitments.

The post First-time buyer affordability concerns outweigh rate worries appeared first on PropertyWire.

title: Bristol pub conversion secures £3.1m development finance
summary:
Shawbrook has provided £3.1m in development finance to convert a former Bristol pub into a 33-bed purpose-built student accommodation scheme. The 16-month facility is funding the redevelopment of The Old Tavern in Stapleton, with the project carrying an estimated gross development value of approximately £4.6m.
